acceptanceCriteria: The stock 7.1 autoload_lib(ignore: %w[assets tasks]) line resolves lib/ as an autoload root minus the ignored subdirs; an app/models change stays BOUNDED (test)
Non-literal autoload_lib arguments still yield ruby:rails-autoload
conformance/ruby-profile-v0 gains a 7.1 variant row; RUBY-AFFECTED-V0 amended
body: Residual from V1-1830/V1-1799 (PR #1156). A stock Rails 7.1+ config/application.rb contains `config.autoload_lib(ignore: %w[assets tasks])`. internal/rubyautoload counts it as unresolved autoload-root config (autoloadRootConfig regex, internal/rubyautoload/rubyautoload.go:52), so every app selection is UNKNOWN with ruby:rails-autoload. Expected: read as the default lib root with the ignore list, giving BOUNDED. The conformance/ruby-profile-v0 fixture uses the 7.0 form to avoid it.
title: Ruby affected: stock Rails 7.1 config.autoload_lib(ignore: %w[assets tasks]) makes selection UNKNOWN (ruby:rails-autoload)
